text: The subject Mehwish Zafar holds account PK**HABB****1661 which was opened on 26 October 2025. The declared occupation is Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 April 2026 to 11 April 2026 the account recorded 28 credits totalling PKR 1,450,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 1,306,000. All 28 credits arrived via interbank (IBFT) transfers from 23 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 11 April 2026, with the typology MULE-01 scoring 360 against a threshold of 300. Overall, the pattern of numerous senders, rapid outflow and volume far exceeding a Student’s declared income is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 849,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 457,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 3 transactions. No match was found on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media screening on 29 April 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review as noted by L2 analyst on 12 April 2026, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
